doc: Cases for the LIVE eval of Starling (tests/starling-live.mjs). Each is one chat turn: the stored history, the slip on screen, the player's message. `expect` is graded in code, never by a model. The answers recorded from this run (tests/fixtures/starling-answers.json) are what tests/starling.mjs and tests/starling-chat.mjs replay through a local stub, the drafter's recorded-answer pattern.
